# A gun turret for the gunboat: a dark drum 0.44 across with a barrel 0.45 long to -Y. Pivot at the drum's base centre (the game turns it to aim).
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Dark --base-color 0.224 0.165 0.110 --no-slot
material new Steel --base-color 0.573 0.494 0.416 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Drum --vertices 8 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.16 --location 0 0 0.08
material assign Dark
add mesh cube --name Barrel1 --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.300 0.100
scale 0.100 0.420 0.100
apply --scale
select Barrel1
material assign Steel
select all
shade flat
export turret.glb
